exposure.needed: whether CI pipelines run `flux push artifact --provider azure` on Azure DevOps runners (this is a CLI call, not a controller container arg)

consequence.statement: This is a bug fix: on Azure DevOps runners, `flux push artifact --provider azure` can now use Azure CLI calls. Operators don't need to do anything.

assertion.statement: In Flux 2.7.0, `flux push artifact --provider azure` can call the Azure CLI when it runs on Azure DevOps runners.
